selected.author: Afloat16
selected.full_inventory_search_source: Complete disjoint created-date-partitioned closed-author PR search, merged_at present.
selected.summary_en: Serialize operator retries and cancellations with concurrent generation-state transitions.

selected.technical_value: Re-reads the scoped generation job under the same PostgreSQL row lock used by generation completion, evaluates the transition and updates state within one transaction. Queue operations and audit publication occur after that transaction.
selected.test_evidence: Committed PostgreSQL integration fixtures use isolated schemas, real row locks, gated concurrent requests and lock-wait inspection. They cover retry conflicts after processing or completion, duplicate retries, cancellation racing with completion and simultaneous cancellations.
selected.limitations: The integration suite requires CLAUDE_MEM_TEST_POSTGRES_URL and skips when it is absent. No database-backed test was executed during this review. Queue I/O remains outside the row-lock transaction.
selected.selection_reason: Addresses concurrent state mutation through transactional row-lock discipline, with explicit race-oriented integration fixtures.
selected.review_method: Inspected the exact final merge-commit production and regression-test patches. Test evidence is from committed fixtures, without a fresh execution.

selected.selection_reason: Prevents a destructive ordering error in the restore workflow and validates both refusal and compatible-snapshot controls.

selected.limitations: Not an original RoPE algorithm. The final merged diff contains the production helper and documentation only, with no added regression test file. Parameter names/shapes remain load-compatible, but existing world-predictor outputs and training losses change; pretrained quality requires separate evaluation. The world predictor is training-only, so no closed-loop robot performance, inference-quality or full-suite/GPU validation improvement is claimed. Tests were not rerun during this review.
selected.limitations_zh: 不是RoPE算法原创。最终合并只包含生产helper与文档，没有新增回归测试文件。参数名称/形状仍可加载，但已有世界预测器输出与训练损失会变化，预训练质量需另行评估。该预测器仅用于训练，不宣称闭环机器人性能、推理质量或全套/GPU验证提升；本轮未重跑测试。

Production comments link V-JEPA 2 PR #15 and checkpoint-compatibility PR #75.
Merged documentation states that the world model is not needed for inference and that existing checkpoints load but produce different predictor outputs/losses.
selected.test_evidence: The final upstream commit changes the production helper and compatibility documentation. No regression-test file was added.
selected.review_method: Inspected the exact final merge commit patch. Regression evidence is from committed tests, without a fresh execution.

other_accepted.maintainer_pr_description:
Supersedes #1140, #1141, #1142, #1143, #1144, #1145 and #1146 by @Afloat16. Each one edits `docs/ROADMAP.md` and `docs/STATUS.md`, so merging them one at a time would have left each later one in conflict. They're merged together here with the author's commits kept.

- #1140: inline source-map data URLs ignore their fragment, and the scheme and `base64` marker are matched case-insensitively.
- #1141: ZIP directories are recognised from DOS and Unix attributes even without a trailing slash.
- #1142: rejected ASAR names count toward the listing limit.
- #1143: a HAR with a UTF-8 BOM parses.
- #1144: a .NET bundle member can't read into the manifest's bytes.
- #1145: Play can start a Python project's one installed `[project.scripts]` console script from its own environment.
- #1146: Godot and Electron get an absolute project path.

Two fixes on top of the merge:
- #1145 and #1146 each edited the New-project toolchains row in STATUS. It's now one row carrying both additions, not two copies.
- #1146's `launch_tests` module is moved to the end of `outputs.rs`. On Windows an item after it made clippy fail with `items_after_test_module`, which the Linux gate doesn't compile.

**Verified:** the `formats` and `engine` tests (552 in the engine library), clippy for both on Windows, fmt, `cargo xtask wasm` and layers pass on the merged result.

Merged through #6028, thank you @Afloat16! Your six commits are on main unchanged, under your name (8889efb51..0ead36aa4, plus our note in 83929a88e). Since this branch doesn't allow maintainer edits, I rehosted it and added one small commit of our own: the guide now says up front that AutoGen is archived upstream and no longer maintained by Microsoft, and points new projects to the Microsoft Agent Framework guide (the note asked for on #5908). It also fixes "a AutoGen" to "an AutoGen". AutoGen users still get your `McpWorkbench` subclass that filters to the four memory tools, binds the project and fails on tool errors.

A maintainer follow-up will remove the `CLAUDE_MEM_WORKER_IDLE_EXIT_SECONDS` line (not a real setting) and group the framework guides in the nav.

other_accepted.limitations: Maintainer added an upstream-archival note and grammar fix after the six Afloat16 commits; that extra commit is not attributed to Afloat16. Shared documentation navigation conflicts were resolved during rehosting.

other_accepted.source_pr_title: Preserve literal filenames when marking ignored files
other_accepted.attribution: The maintainer explicitly credits Afloat16's literal-filename handling and regression cases from #1250 within #1137. The final squash retains the Afloat co-author trailer. Only this contribution is credited, not the complete Linux watcher implementation.
other_accepted.summary_en: Preserve literal filenames in Git ignore checks and retain the associated regression cases.
other_accepted.summary_zh: 在 Git 忽略判断中保留字面文件名，并纳入对应回归案例。

maintainer_acknowledgment.author: danyaberezun
maintainer_acknowledgment.body: Thanks @Afloat16 — the literal-filename fix landed as part of #1137, credited to you as co-author. #1137 rewrote the same `ignoredPaths` function (a fast `--no-index` first pass), so we folded your fix in there rather than merge two competing versions: the first pass reads `./<path>` records from `--stdin -z`, and the index pass keeps arguments (one index scan per batch — `--stdin` rescans the index per path, ~3× slower on large repos) and unquotes git's C-quoted names, so `"`, `\`, control characters and pathspec-looking names stay literal. Your tests for those names came along. Closing this in favour of #1137.

other_accepted.limitations: The final implementation differs from the source PR: the no-index pass uses NUL-delimited stdin, while the index pass uses bounded arguments and C-quoted path decoding. The entire watcher optimization and its performance results are not attributed to Afloat16. No tests were rerun.
